knowledge.condition: 既有紧凑住宅中，委托目标是尽可能扩大起居空间，同时保留生活设施。
knowledge.reason: 把相关服务功能集中组织，使其余空间能够连续用于起居。
knowledge.scope_limit: The source decision organizes bed, kitchen, bathroom/toilet and storage together. Furniture moves can test only an explicitly named subdecision; no plumbing, construction or full dwelling reproduction is claimed.

knowledge.condition: 同一紧凑居住空间需要支持不同活动；在需要较大空地的状态下，可以调整可移动家具。
knowledge.decision: Move the lightweight sofa and other movable furniture to adapt the activity space.
knowledge.reason: 调整轻型沙发等可移动家具的位置，为变化的活动腾出空间。
knowledge.scope_limit: Murphy-bed articulation, forces/weight and furniture internal mechanisms are not validated. Partial movement evidence does not imply whole-room activity switching success.

knowledge.condition: 紧凑、低层高住宅兼顾开敞感与收纳。
knowledge.decision: 主要区域采用低矮家具，高柜藏于入口。
knowledge.reason: 减少高大家具对主要空间的影响，同时安排收纳。
knowledge.scope_limit: No exact cabinet capacity, daylight/perception result or reproduced entry concealment; family already exposed in earlier Paris source review.

knowledge.condition: 年轻家庭改造既有住宅，需要卧室、起居与收纳。
knowledge.decision: 双面可取用的通高柜分隔卧室和起居。
knowledge.reason: 分隔与收纳结合，双面取用提供使用灵活性。
knowledge.scope_limit: Ordinary static cabinet geometry cannot establish double-sided access, storage capacity or usable internal construction.

knowledge.condition: 紧凑住宅的主生活空间同时具有木质功能墙。
knowledge.decision: 主空间采用白色表面，厨房和浴室用单色蓝色区分。
knowledge.reason: 设计师说明白色用于增强明亮感并凸显木墙材质。
knowledge.scope_limit: Brightness/perception and material contrast have not been measured; current static proxies/rendering do not reproduce finishes or lighting.

knowledge.condition: 旧公寓需随日常用途改变分隔。
knowledge.decision: 用可展开屏风调整分隔，并结合部分透光材料。
knowledge.reason: 物理分隔的同时保留光线连续性。
knowledge.scope_limit: Hinges/tracks, folding clearance, light transmission and privacy have not been implemented or validated. Static screen placement is not equivalent.
